subject.title: [Bug]: Slack multi-workspace: outbound works on second workspace but inbound DM replies never reach OpenClaw

question: Should maintainers require live two-workspace Slack Socket Mode proof before assigning a fix PR for this issue?
rationale: The issue is credible and corroborated, but source inspection only identifies adjacent account-scoped paths and does not isolate the current failing layer.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Ask for redacted gateway logs or run a two-workspace Slack Socket Mode fixture before opening a code fix so the patch targets the real drop point.

options.title: Sponsor a targeted investigation PR
options.body: A maintainer can choose to investigate directly in the Slack plugin, but the first PR should be diagnostic or test-backed rather than assuming a root cause.

options.title: Close after a passing live check
options.body: If current main or the latest release passes the two-workspace secondary-DM flow, close with the exact release or commit proof.

recommendation.title: Require live repro first
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted gateway logs or run a two-workspace Slack Socket Mode fixture before opening a code fix so the patch targets the real drop point.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest history on Slack multi-account routing and the account/team filtering boundary involved here.
